verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LibreOffice's document conversion CLI and a Writer SVG export filter, which converts documents to SVG rather than converting images between formats. Nothing documents PNG, JPEG, WebP or HEIC conversion, and nothing documents control over image quality, size or compression. The SVG export filter is an adjacent document-export feature and does not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a power user, common image formats (PNG, JPEG, WebP, HEIC, SVG) convert with control over quality, size, and compression
